name: 素材采集
desc: 用一句话描述想要的素材，AI 解析成需求卡片、缺什么补什么，确认后从公开站点搜索候选；勾选才下载，图片入当前工作台素材库，视频保存为收藏条目
descEn: Describe the assets you want; AI turns it into a requirement card, searches public sites after your confirmation, and only downloads what you check
features: 卡片式需求确认：类型/主题/用途/风格/数量，缺必填项高亮追问，确认后才开始
结果先以候选网格呈现，勾选哪些才下载哪些（不自动落地）
图片入 source/image（命名「日期-描述」）；视频保存为收藏条目（含封面与链接）
来源只搜公开图片/视频站点；只在当前工作台读写
颜色与字体全部取当前主题（四套主题自动适配）
featuresEn: Card-style requirement check: type/subject/usage/style/count with required-field prompts
Candidates as a grid — only checked items are downloaded
Images go to source/image (named date-description); videos become favorite entries with cover and link
Public image/video sites only; current workspace only
All colors/fonts come from the active theme
author: 随手社区
